<!-- Each pull request must be associated with an open issue unless it's a documentation fix. If a corresponding issue does not exist, please create one so we can discuss the change first. -->

<!-- Please answer the following. We close pull requests that don't. -->

> Which issue, if any, is this issue related to?

Similar to https://github.com/stylelint/stylelint/pull/9061

> Is there anything in the PR that needs further explanation?

This PR changes the rule to only call `fork` if the `*syntax` secondary options are used, or if the file being linted contains `@property` at-rules extending the syntax, otherwise the rule uses the cached lexer from `context`.

I'll open an issue to remove the (now redundant since we added `languageOption`) secondary options, so only the more performant `languageOption` is available. It seems forking on new definitions in a file is unavoidable, though.

Benchmarked using our standard config:

```
export default {
	extends: ['stylelint-config-standard'],
};
```

Nearly halves the time when running our config on 1000 CSS files:

```
# Before
 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Size      Files   Rules   Overrides   Time        ±CV     Per file  Memory      
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Small     20      0       0           247.03ms    2.2%    12.35ms   201.36 MB   
  Medium    100     0       0           701.05ms    1.2%    7.01ms    438.20 MB   
  Large     500     0       0           2.82s       1.4%    5.63ms    471.03 MB   
  X-Large   1000    0       0           5.45s       0.2%    5.45ms    575.78 MB   
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# After
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Size      Files   Rules   Overrides   Time        ±CV     Per file  Memory      
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Small     20      0       0           192.60ms    2.2%    9.63ms    163.20 MB   
  Medium    100     0       0           436.75ms    1.1%    4.37ms    272.27 MB   
  Large     500     0       0           1.58s       0.5%    3.15ms    448.00 MB   
  X-Large   1000    0       0           2.95s       0.5%    2.95ms    604.58 MB   
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Comparison

 Size      Baseline    Current     Diff        Change    Status    
  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Small     247.03ms    192.60ms    54.43ms     -22.0%    ✓ Faster  
  Medium    701.05ms    436.75ms    264.30ms    -37.7%    ✓ Faster  
  Large     2.82s       1.58s       1.24s       -44.1%    ✓ Faster  
  X-Large   5.45s       2.95s       2.50s       -45.8%    ✓ Faster  
  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

And the cumulative gains combined with https://github.com/stylelint/stylelint/pull/9061:

```
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  PERFORMANCE COMPARISON
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Size      Baseline    Current     Diff        Change    Status    
  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Small     247.03ms    147.65ms    99.38ms     -40.2%    ✓ Faster  
  Medium    701.05ms    273.86ms    427.19ms    -60.9%    ✓ Faster  
  Large     2.82s       823.33ms    1.99s       -70.8%    ✓ Faster  
  X-Large   5.45s       1.33s       4.12s       -75.6%    ✓ Faster  
  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
judge_input.title: Fix `declaration-property-value-no-unknown` performance
